ModulePrefs.title: keplerwee1
ModulePrefs.author: Juan M. Aguirregabiria (http://tp.lc.ehu.es/jma.html); lookang; tina
ModulePrefs.description: The simulation displays the evolution of a 2-body system under the action of mutual (attractive or repulsive) Newtonian forces. The evolution of the equivalent one-dimensional problem is also displayed along with the effective potential energy.
